lado_card.texto: After the diagnosis comes course 2: implement the first assistant, coach the owner and the team, and accompany them until they can run it on their own.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/consultoria-ia · Professional 2030 · inema.club

inicio.lead: Before you put AI into a small business, you need to understand the business. In eight lessons you interview the owner, score the 5 areas, pull out of their head the rules nobody wrote down, and deliver a one-page map with one recommendation and a 30-day plan.
inicio.capa_alt: Reception desk of a small clinic with an open notebook and the course title: Diagnosis, the Client Map.

numeros.t: fictional company from start to finish

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of a diagnosis: understand the business, interview, score, extract the rules, prioritize, check the risk, and deliver one page.

itens: Small business owners (clinic, real estate agency, bakery, repair shop, store) who want to bring AI into their own business with a method.
Beginner consultants who serve small businesses and need to deliver a diagnosis the owner can understand.
People who have already sold the diagnosis and now need to do it well.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Run the diagnostic interview with 15 questions and clear consent to record.
Score the business's 5 areas with a written criterion for each grade.
Turn cases the owner tells you into tested IF/THEN rules.
Deliver a one-page report with 1 recommendation, what stays out, and a 30-day plan.
Professional 2030 has four roles: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor, and Trainer. All four sell trust, not building.
The DICA Program is the Consultant role, scaled to the small business: an owner who decides alone, no IT department, with WhatsApp at the center.
DICA = Diagnose, Implement, Coach, Accompany. This course is the D; course 2 is the I, the C, and the A.

blocos.t: What was covered in Selling with AI
itens: The 4 roles and "what you are not": Selling with AI 1 and prof2030-base.
Discovery call to sell: Selling with AI 2.
Pricing, proposal, and first client: Selling with AI 4.
